name: OmniHand Pro
summary: OmniHand Pro is AgiBot's professional dexterous hand for complex manipulation and tool use. The official technical documentation identifies 12 active and 19 total degrees of freedom in a hand weighing no more than 820 g. Fingertip three-dimensional force sensing provides contact information for controlled manipulation, while CAN FD supplies the communication interface. The manufacturer lists a typical 0.7-second opening or closing time and 0.4 mm fingertip repeatability. Left- and right-hand packages are documented separately, and the specifications remain configuration-dependent manufacturer
